`libretro.h` is the MIT-licensed upstream API header from
[libretro-common](https://github.com/libretro/libretro-common/blob/master/include/libretro.h),
downloaded on 2026-10-04. Its copyright and license notice are retained in the file.
It is used only by the native smoke-test frontend; the core's corresponding C#
layouts are in `src/GameWave.Libretro/RetroAbi.cs`.
